<thought>Based on the molecular formula C9H8O4, DBE 6, six aromatic carbons, one methyl group and two carbonyl groups, the compound is aspirin (acetyl‑salicylic acid). It can be viewed as the combination of a benzoic‑acid fragment and an acetyl (acetate) fragment. The SMILES for these fragments are “c1ccc(cc1)C(=O)O” (benzoic acid) and “CC(=O)O” (acetate).</thought>
<final_answer>['c1ccc(cc1)C(=O)O', 'CC(=O)O']</final_answer>
